title: Lapse Re-Quote Uplift Card — Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas
content:
A lapse re-quote uplift is added to the Commercial Natural Gas Supply offer price for the days the offer has stood since the rollover, counted in calendar days from the plan change date to the acceptance date. The uplift is a per-therm amount added to the offer price once.

| Calendar days from the plan change date to the acceptance date | Uplift per therm |
|---|---|
| 11 or more | $0.0150 |
| At least 6 and fewer than 11 | $0.0080 |
| Fewer than 6 | None |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical plan change date 2026-01-01)

| Acceptance date | Days since the plan change date | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-06 | 5 | None |
| 2026-01-07 | 6 | $0.0080 |
| 2026-01-11 | 10 | $0.0080 |
| 2026-01-12 | 11 | $0.0150 |
| 2026-01-16 | 15 | $0.0150 |

On a hypothetical offer price of $0.5800, an acceptance 8 days after the plan change date carries an uplift of $0.0080 per therm.
